title: Theresa May withdraws extradition order

tellings.quote: I have therefore withdrawn the expedition extradition order against Mr. McKinnon.

plain: In 2012 the British government withdrew its order to send a man named McKinnon to the United States. McKinnon is the hacker the episode is about, who says he found signs of a secret NASA space program. The show plays a clip of Theresa May telling the UK Parliament: "I have therefore withdrawn the extradition order against Mr. McKinnon," which meant he would not face trial in America.
